newsitem.title: INDIA: FedEx, Blue Dart map India inroads.
newsitem.headline: FedEx, Blue Dart map India inroads.

text.p: U.S. express transport company Federal Express Corp (FedEx) announced an exclusive agreement on Wednesday to use Blue Dart Express Ltd services to enter the Indian market for international shipments.

Blue Dart will provide pick up, domestic transportation, customs clearance and delivery services for FedEX International Priority shipment, and be the sole preferred consolidator of FedEx services, the two companies announced in a statement.

"FedEx is making this long term committment to the Indian market in order to meet the strong growth of exports to India's key trading partners, especially the United States, where FedEx is the market leader," Robert Elliot, vice president of sales and customer technology for FedEx Europe, Africa, Middle East and Indian sub-continent, said.
Blue Dart has been FedEx's Global Service participant in India since 1984.

"Together since 1984, we have developed a substantial air express business base in India and are now positioned to take our relationship forward and reap the full benefit of India's increasing integration into the global market place," Clyde Cooper, managing director of Blue Dart, said.
To support the new agreement a dedicated FedEx "round the world" DC 10 flight is planned to be lauched in September, connecting Bombay directly to FedEx's international network.
Hamdi Osman, FedEx managing director of operations for the Middle East and Indian sub-continent, said the dedicated international flight will allow more focus on heavy weight express services.

Blue Dart operates 48 all-cargo flights per week in India, using its own B737 aircraft between the cities of Bangalore, Bombay, Calcutta, Delhi and Madras. It serves 760 locations and has 600 collection centres throughout India and handles nine million shipments annually.
